subject: general
question: The Sattriya dance form was introduced by ________ in 15th Century AD in Assam.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mahapurusha Srimanta Sankaradeva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sattriya dance form was introduced in the 15th century A.D by the great Vaishnava saint and reformer of Assam.
 
• The dance form evolved and expanded as a distinctive style of dance later on.
 
• Due to its of its religious character and association with the Sattras, this dance style has been aptly named Sattriya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
